C2​H5​OH+O2 ​→CO2​+H2​O

Step 1: Balance Carbon (C) atoms

· Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) has 2 carbon atoms.

· On the right side, we need 2 CO₂ molecules to balance the carbon atoms.

· C2​H5​OH+O2 ​→2CO2​+H2​O

Step 2: Balance Hydrogen (H) atoms

· Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) has 6 hydrogen atoms.

· Since each water molecule (H₂O) contains 2 hydrogen atoms, we need 3 H₂O molecules to balance the hydrogen.

C2​H5​OH+O2 ​→2CO2​+3H2​O

Step 3: Balance Oxygen (O) atoms

· On the left, we have:

o Ethanol (C₂H₅OH): 1 oxygen atom.

o Oxygen molecule (O₂): contributes 2 oxygen atoms per molecule.

· On the right:

o 2 CO₂ molecules contribute 4 oxygen atoms.

o 3 H₂O molecules contribute 3 oxygen atoms.

Thus, the right side has 4 + 3 = 6 oxygen atoms.

· To balance oxygen on the left side, we need 3 O₂ molecules (3 X 2 = 6 oxygen atoms), plus the 1 oxygen atom from ethanol.

· C2​H5​OH+O2 ​→2CO2​+3H2​O

Step 4: Verify the Balancing

· Carbon atoms: 2 on both sides

· Hydrogen atoms: 6 on both sides

· Oxygen atoms: 6 on both sides

Final Answer:

The number of CO₂ and H₂O molecules in the balanced equation is 2 and 3, respectively.

4) 10x + 14y - 16 = 0

Slope = -10/14 = -5/7 (same slope as the given equation, but same intercept)

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Rearrange the given segments to form a coherent sentence. O: that the Soviet army had liberated P: from the fascist forces came under Q: the East European countries R: the control of the USSR S: after the Second World War

questions.solution:

· Q: The East European countries

Thus, SQOPR is the correct order.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Rohit did not slap Kunal.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Rohit did not slap Kunal.

options.text: Kunal was not being slapped by Rohit.
options.html: Kunal was not being slapped by Rohit.

options.text: Kunal had not been slapped by Rohit.
options.html: Kunal had not been slapped by Rohit.

options.text: Kunal was not slapped by Rohit.
options.html: Kunal was not slapped by Rohit.

options.text: Kunal has not been slapped by Rohit.
options.html: Kunal has not been slapped by Rohit.

questions.solution:
Passive voice is formed as:

Object + auxiliary verb + past participle + by + subject

· Active: Rohit did not slap Kunal.

· Passive: Kunal was not slapped by Rohit.

Now, analyzing

· Option 1: "Was not being slapped" (incorrect tense).

· Option 2: "Had not been slapped" (past perfect, unnecessary here).

· Option 3: "Was not slapped" (correct past simple passive).

· Option 4: "Has not been slapped" (present perfect, incorrect).

Thus, Option 3 is correct.
